title: Сделать source/archive object write условием успешной версии
summary: Исправить A6: source download и archive child создают version/status/event только после подтверждённого object write, а same-hash retry долечивает partial state идемпотентно. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/artifacts-PARSING_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE.json:182-194`).
why: При `throw=false` `put()` может вернуть false, но DB утверждает `Downloaded`; crash между version/status/event оставляет hash-no-op, который не восстанавливается. RAG:✅ 2026-09-10 — Laravel failed-write semantics зафиксирована в `@plan/knowledge/findings-00-source-synthesis.json`.

include: checked write false/exception paths; object existence/readability verification appropriate to disk; short DB transaction for version/status/event after object success; same-hash reconciliation of object/DB partial states; archive child parity; orphan object cleanup/deferred marker on DB failure; fault tests for each crash boundary.
exclude: pretending S3 and PostgreSQL share one transaction; representation writes (P3.3); retry selection (P3.1); storage vendor replacement.

rules: Object write precedes DB success; checked `false` and exception are equivalent failure. `FinalizeDocumentDownloadAction` is sole short DB transaction for version/status/event. Retry must reconcile four observable cases: neither exists, object-only, version-only/missing object, fully consistent; status `Downloaded` only in the last. Content hash deduplicates bytes, not recovery work. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).
guidance: Fault matrix injects: false put, exception put, DB exception after object, exception after version before status/event via action rollback, same-hash retry with missing object. Assert no phantom successful version/status/event and exactly-one final version/event after heal. Do not use `exists()` alone if target adapter cannot prove readable complete bytes; use a deterministic write/read or checksum contract. No `try/catch` that converts failure to success. Preserve unrelated config dirty state if present.
